briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ +0.2%, S&P 500 +0.1%), so we stayed disciplined rather than chasing the whole candidate list. We used one of our three open slots on AERO, the strongest technically-confirmed setup, and are holding the rest of our cash and slots in reserve for a clearer risk-on signal.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Instead of buying on just one bullish sign, experienced investors look for several indicators to agree at once — like RSI showing healthy (not overheated) momentum, MACD confirming an upward crossover, and price trading above its moving average. When multiple signals line up, it's more likely a real trend rather than random noise.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 有經驗的投資者不會單憑一個利好訊號就出手，而是等待多個技術指標同時確認——例如RSI顯示健康（未過熱）的上升動能、MACD出現黃金交叉、股價站上均線之上。當多個訊號同時出現時，代表這更可能是真實的上升趨勢，而非隨機波動。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices were essentially flat today, with the NASDAQ up 0.2% and the S&P 500 up 0.1%, reflecting a quiet, directionless session rather than any major catalyst. No single sector or headline drove meaningful moves, so most stocks traded near their prior levels. This kind of low-volatility day often precedes a bigger move once new information (like earnings or economic data) arrives.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢平淡，納指微升0.2%，標普500僅升0.1%，市場缺乏明確方向，亦未見重大消息刺激。由於沒有特定板塊或新聞主導走勢，大部分股票價格維持在近日水平附近。這類低波動的交易日，往往預示著市場在等待新的消息（例如業績或經濟數據）出爐後才會有較大變動。

trades.reasoning: Highest-scoring candidate (95) with full multi-signal confirmation — RSI in bullish zone, MACD bullish crossover with rising histogram, and price above SMA-20 — indicating a genuine uptrend worth funding even on an otherwise neutral day.
